text: On February 2 and 3, 2022, City Council adopted the settlement offer for the appealed Zoning By-law Amendment application (20 155716 STE 12 OZ) at 10 to 32 Raglan Avenue allowing a 97.5-metre (28 storeys, excluding mechanical penthouse) mixed-use building. The resulting Site Specific By-laws 1173-2022 (OLT) and 1174-2022 (OLT) were enacted on September 16, 2022. The Council approval ( Item 2022.CC39.7 - 10-32 Raglan Avenue - Zoning By-law Amendment Application - Ontario Land Tribunal Hearing - Request for Further Directions ) secured a set of Section 37 Planning Act Community Benefits.
